description: Covers EU bans and limits on skin, hair and makeup ingredients, plus fragrance allergens and brand recalls. Send an ingredient list, product name or barcode. For a medicine or food, use Medicine or Food.

barcode.description: UPC or EAN on the package

ingredients.description: The INCI ingredient list, comma separated, e.g. 'Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Phenoxyethanol'

product.description: Product name with brand, e.g. 'CeraVe Moisturizing Cream'

product_type.description: Product form, such as face_cream or body_lotion, when known

query.description: Product name, barcode or comma-separated ingredients

name: check_cosmetic
title: Cosmetics: ingredients, rules, recalls
